mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) are associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as reduced interest rates lower the cost of capital and stimulate economic activity, leading to higher equity valuations.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS level shows no correlation with 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% within the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering a short-term equity sell-off and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The UNRATE threshold condition (UNRATE > 5.5%) is met in more than 30% of 5-day windows, but the subsequent 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) indicate a severe economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and RSAFS both decline in the past month
failure_condition: The joint condition (INDPRO and RSAFS both decline) is met in more than 30% of 60-day windows, but the subsequent 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising for two consecutive months), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased risk aversion and reduced liquidity.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising for two consecutive months
failure_condition: The regime condition (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising for two consecutive months) is met in more than 30% of 20-day windows, but the subsequent 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: Lower housing starts (HOUST) are associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as it signals weak consumer demand and economic slowdown, reducing equity valuations.
failure_condition: HOUST level shows no correlation with 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 900 units within the past month signals a housing market collapse, triggering a short-term equity sell-off and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST falls below 900 in more than 30% of 5-day windows, but the subsequent 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% and declines in employment (PAYEMS) indicate a severe labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.5% and PAYEMS declines in the past month
failure_condition: The joint condition (UNRATE > 5.5% and PAYEMS decline) is met in more than 30% of 60-day windows, but the subsequent 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 within the past month signals a recessionary contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 105 in more than 30% of 20-day windows, but the subsequent 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of those instances.
